set.body:
Neither sandwich helper is reachable from fmri_lm(). compute_sandwich_variance
(R/fmri_lm_contrasts.R:246) and calculate_sandwich_variance (R/effective_df.R:88)
have zero call sites in R/. The live robust path uses a model-based WLS variance,
se = sqrt(diag((X'WX)^-1)) * sigma_robust.

Three places claim otherwise:
  R/sandwich_variance_doc.R:23 - "Sandwich variance estimation is automatically used
    when: Robust regression is enabled ..." (ships to users as man/sandwich_variance.Rd)
  README.md:36 - "and sandwich variance estimators"
  CLAUDE.md:157 - "checkmark Sandwich variance estimator"

The arithmetic bug in compute_sandwich_variance (X'diag(e^4)X instead of
X'diag(e^2)X, 3.5x too large) has been FIXED and is now covered against
sandwich::vcovHC in tests/testthat/test-variance-closed-form.R. The functions are
correct but still dead.

Decide: wire them into the robust path (needs the proper M-estimator influence-
function sandwich, not the OLS formula), or correct all three claims. Do not leave a
documented estimator that is never computed.
set.title: Docs: package advertises a sandwich variance estimator it never uses
